# DSH ClinePass

ClinePass plugin for DeepSeek Harness, maintained in this repository:
xiangnan0811/dsh-clinepass.
中文说明 · Русский

The settings namespace is `dsh-clinebot`, the provider id is `clinebot`, and
the HTTP prefix is `/ds

h-clinebot`. Do not install another plugin that also
registers provider id `clinebot` in the same pr

ofile. Both would write
`llm-pi-ai.providers.clinebot`.
The package name is `dsh-clinepass`. `private: true` blocks `npm publish`.
## Install from this repository
Version `0.8.0` requires DeepSeek Harness `^0.2.1-rc.2`.
DeepSeek Harness installs plugins with pnpm. A GitHub spec is enough:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh`. **ClineBot** is in the settings sidebar. The sidebar **Plugins** page also opens it f
rom the `dsh-clinebot` row inside `dsh-clinepass`. Settings → Built-in plugins is a read-only invent
ory and no longer hosts this card.

`npm publish` is not required for the DSH plugin market in the sidebar
(`dsh-market`). That market i

nstalls with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo`.
Publishing to npm is only needed for
`dsh plugin --profile web add <npm-name>`.

This repository is not a GitHub fork. The market lists it after the topic
`dsh-plugin` is on the Abo

ut page and `cordis.patch.yml` is in the root.
The index runs around 06:00 and still checks that the

repo is a DSH plugin.
A submission issue on 2BingLing/dsh-market
is the other way in.

Do not export `CLINEBOT_API_KEY` in the shell that starts `dsh`. DSH treats
that variable as read-on

ly and rejects a key saved from the settings page.
Save the key in the plugin card. The browser call

s
`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-clinebot/...` on the local DSH server. The plugin
then calls `baseUrl
`, which should be `https://api.cline.bot/api/v1`.
## What the settings card does

- Saves the API address and the ClinePass key.
- Shows 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage from
`GET /

users/me/plan/usage-limits`, with the percent, a meter, and a reset
date. Account, plan, and last fe

tch time are separate rows. The account
email is masked until you choose Show email. A cancellation

timestamp from the plan is an extra row.
When more than one key is saved, the other accounts are lis

ted with their
three percents. That list does not change which account is chosen after a
rate limit.

- Registers the selected models into DSH. The output cap is not sent as
`max_tokens`. The request b

udget is. The default budget is 65536.
- Adds selection shortcuts, search, optional verified-plan fi

ltering, batch
defaults and custom model forms. An explicit empty selection registers none.
Individu

al overrides take precedence over batch defaults. Restoring model
capabilities leaves the request bu

dget unchanged; it has its own reset.
- Validates an entered key without saving, or scans known Clin

e CLI, VS Code,
Cursor files and Cline environment variables when requested. Discovery shows
masked

values; five-minute server handles import selected keys into the account
pool. Encrypted editor secr

ets may not be discoverable.
- Lets you pick the smoke-test model. Muse Spark uses
`reasoning_effort

: low` and a 1024-token cap so the short reply is not
swallowed by reasoning.
- Saves request statis

tics per DSH profile: results, attempts, latency and
reported token counters. Filter by UTC date, mo

del or account, export CSV, or
reset statistics from the settings card. `/cline stats` and `/cline t

elemetry`
show the same profile totals. Prompts and credential values are never stored.
- A sidebar

quota button opens the host's detail modal with quotas, statistics
and full configuration, including

a narrow-screen entry. Reset countdowns keep
missing times and usage unknown. Sidebar and composer

displays default on and
have separate switches.
- Composer usage comes from the current session's Cl

inePass reply/attempt
projection, excluding other providers. Cost estimates price uncached input,

## Configuration

Catalog synchronization starts at about 0.5 seconds, with conditional retries at
3 and 15 seconds. A

n hourly check refreshes results older than six hours. Manual
sync uses the same writer and freshnes

s timestamp. Failures retain valid data;
disable/unload cancels reads and invalidates late writes. Q

uota polling does not
fetch the full catalog. Cache v4 isolates the API address, account and credent

ial
fingerprint; older caches are refetched. A failed cache save shows a warning while
settings and

model calls remain usable. Custom `modelsCachePath` writes must stay
inside `DSH_HOME` as a safe `.j

son` file (`profiles/` entries must start with
`clinebot-`). Invalid or failed `image_url` blocks in

chat payloads are downgraded
to plain text blocks before upstream calls in both proxy and direct mo

t payloads are downgraded
to plain text blocks before upstream calls in both proxy and direct modes.

FREE badges/filtering use exact IDs from the gateway's explicit recommendation
`free` list, verified

on 2026-10-29. Names and zero reference prices are not free
evidence; directory metadata does not v

erify account access or billing. Dated
models use exact listed IDs and version-specific metadata, wi

thout rewriting
vendor IDs to Pass IDs, extending verified plan membership or importing models.

The proxy cools HTTP 402 for five minutes per account and exact model, and can
try another account b

efore the first output. Other models on that account remain
available. Recovery can target one model

; account-only API requests still clear
all its cooldowns. Direct calls, probes and smoke tests do n

ot rotate the global
account on 402. HTTP 413 and recognized request-size errors fail without retry

or
account rotation, with advice to reduce messages/images or start a new session.
Context token ove

rflow remains separate. New statistics distinguish insufficient
credits, rate limits and oversized r
equests; historical aggregates are not reclassified.
